scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --minify --format=esm --target=es2020 --outfile=../internal/web/dist/app.js && cp node_modules/uplot/dist/uPlot.min.css ../internal/web/dist/uplot.css && npm run build:pev2
scripts.build:pev2: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('../internal/web/dist/pev2',{recursive:true,force:true})" && esbuild vue=vue pev2=pev2 --bundle --splitting --minify --format=esm --target=es2020 --outdir=../internal/web/dist/pev2 --chunk-names=chunk-[hash] --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' --define:__VUE_OPTIONS_API__=true --define:__VUE_PROD_DEVTOOLS__=false --define:__VUE_PROD_HYDRATION_MISMATCH_DETAILS__=false && cp node_modules/pev2/dist/pev2.css node_modules/bootstrap/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css ../internal/web/dist/pev2/ && cp node_modules/@fortawesome/fontawesome-svg-core/styles.css ../internal/web/dist/pev2/fontawesome.css
